page.layout: One column of running text; page number and running head at the top; catchword alone at the right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: IX. Cassiodorus Divin. Lect. C. viii, mentionem facit gemini in Paulum Commentarij, utriusque in tredecim tantum Epistolas, seclusa illa ad Hebraeos; Prior hodieque visitur in Operibus Hieronymi, Pelagio haeresiarchae adscriptus. Alter Hilario Diacono, coaetaneo Pictavensi, restitutus. De quo Blondellus Apol. pro sententia. Hieronymus Sect. u[?]. Germanum Romanae Ecclesiae alumnum arguit, quod enarratis praecedentibus omnibus Pauli Epistolis, ab ea quam ad Hebraeos Romae dedit Apostolus, adeo manum abstinuit, ut vix semel ejusdem meminisse dignatus sit. Imo quorundam assertio est, Latinorum neminem in hanc Epistolam scripsisse Commentarios, ante Anselmum Cantuariensem.

X. Nodum hunc scriptor Annalium Ecclesiasticorum ut expediat, utque notam illam male definiti Canonis, & rejectae nobilissimae Epistolarum omnium, a Romana abstergat Ecclesia, hanc incedit ille via. Primo, subdole varia & testimo-nia[?] & documenta, de dubia Latinorum vete-

page.notes: Catchword "vete-" is printed at the lower right, as a catchword. Line-end "testimo-" continues on the next line; that continuation is smudged and only partly legible, so "nia" is marked uncertain. "Sect. u" in the Hieronymus citation is printed in a form that is hard to read (probably "Sect. ii"); marked [?]. Running head and page number are as printed. The printed "Epistole" in the running head is transcribed as it appears. The text has no marginal notes.
